title: Houston derecho, Harris County, May 2024
description: Real EAGLE-I replay of the 16 May 2024 derecho in Harris County, TX. Under the current thresholds (theta_lo 0.2, theta_hi 0.9) this window qualifies under R3 (index between theta_lo and theta_hi; a witness must confirm). Missing intervals are shown as gaps.

data_sources.name: EAGLE-I recorded outages 2024 (eaglei_outages_2024.csv, filtered to TX/FL/IL)

provenance.notes: Real data: EAGLE-I county customers out for FIPS 48201, every 15-minute interval from 2024-05-16T00:00:00Z to 2024-05-26T00:00:00Z (end exclusive). share = customers_out / MCC county customers (1,827,686), capped at 1.0. 45 of 960 intervals have no reading and are points with null values; they are never filled. Off-grid timestamps were moved to the start of their 15-minute slot. Timestamps are UTC (data_quality.json timestamp_check). Window chosen before thresholds as the D5 storm window. Under trigger_params.json thresholds: at theta_lo 0.2: run 2024-05-17T00:15:00Z to 2024-05-17T19:30:00Z (19.25 h, reaches 4 h at 2024-05-17T04:15:00Z, never 24 h, 4 bridged intervals); 1 qualifying event(s) after the hours clause. at theta_hi 0.9: no run of 4 h or more. Data quality in this window: see data_quality.json storm_windows (dropout readings bridged by the dropout rule; a frozen value of 131,113 repeats on 20-22 May; no rule is applied to it).
